hero.title: Astra keeps your community active
hero.subtitle: Does your Discord die when the stream ends? Astra is your automated community manager. Daily posts, engagement rankings, weekly reports, and smart FAQ.

features.title: Why choose Astra?
features.subtitle: Everything you need for an engaged and self-sustaining community.
features.f1_desc: Astra asks questions of the day, polls, and challenges for members to interact with every day without you having to think about content.
features.f2_desc: Identify and reward the most active members with a smart anti-spam system and automated roles.
features.f3_desc: Your community can ask Astra questions and she responds based on what you have registered in the dashboard.
features.f4_desc: Advanced word filter, protection against suspicious links and raids, keeping your server always safe.
features.f5_desc: Automatically notifies when you go live or post a new video, with personalized messages.
features.f6_desc: Members earn points for interacting and can exchange them for VIP roles or custom items in the shop.

showcase.subtitle: See how Astra interacts in your server

pricing.subtitle: Start for free and evolve as your community grows.
